fake_vendor.notes: Broader PyPI searches for the full vendor name and zyphrelon-client returned generic matches rather than an identifiable official SDK. The initial direct-project request encountered a human check; after that check was resolved, the project URL displayed PyPI's Page Not Found (404). These findings do not prove that the vendor or an SDK cannot exist under another name.

rows.notes: PyPI identifies this as the Pinecone Python SDK and links to pinecone-io/python-sdk. Both 10.3.0 and 10.2.0 require Python >=3.10. The count includes pre-release 10.1.0rc1. For every verified vendor below, window counts were calculated from the release history's UTC timestamps, from 2026-08-29T00:00:00Z through, but not including, 2026-11-28T00:00:00Z. Each listed version was counted once without excluding pre-releases or yanked releases.

PyPI describes the package as the Qdrant Python client and SDK and links to qdrant/qdrant-client. Both 1.20.0 and 1.19.1 require Python >=3.10. A PyPI human check initially blocked release-page access; completing it restored access, and the release metadata was then read successfully.
PyPI links to weaviate/weaviate-python-client and explicitly identifies client version 4.X as actively supported. Requires Python increased from >=3.10 in 4.24.1 to >=3.11 in 4.25.0.

PyPI identifies chromadb as Chroma's Python client and links to chroma-core/chroma. Both 1.5.9 and 1.5.8 require Python >=3.9. The newest listed release, 1.5.9, has a UTC upload date of 2026-05-05, before the requested window.

Identity confirmed from PyPI's project links to https://moss.dev/, https://docs.moss.dev/, and https://github.com/usemoss/moss, distinguishing this package from unrelated uses of the name Moss. Both 1.26.0 and 1.25.0 require Python >=3.10.

PyPI identifies the package as the Milvus Python SDK and links to milvus-io/pymilvus. Both 3.0.3 and 3.0.2, the preceding stable entry in PyPI's release-history order, require Python >=3.9. The count also includes the older-branch release 2.6.18, uploaded on 2026-11-06 UTC; the history is not strictly chronological across version branches.

PyPI identifies the package as the LanceDB Python SDK and links to lancedb/lancedb. Both 0.41.0 and 0.40.0 require Python >=3.10. The project description also mentions lancedb-compat for older processors; this audit covers the primary lancedb distribution.
PyPI describes this as the turbopuffer Python API library and links to turbopuffer/turbopuffer-python. Both 3.1.0 and 3.0.0 require Python >=3.11.

summary_text: Moss had the most verified release activity in the inclusive UTC window, with 22 releases, followed by Turbopuffer with 9 and Pinecone with 5. Eight vendors' SDK records were verified from PyPI; no official Python SDK could be identified for Zyphrelon Vector Cloud, so its release metrics remain unconfirmed rather than zero.
